recognize_zh: 中倍下淋巴結內一片淡粉紅、細胞稀疏的區域，裡面散佈大量深染的點狀核碎屑與淡染組織球，與周圍較深藍紫色的淋巴組織交界不規則；這種以凋亡碎屑為主、無膿瘍的斑片狀壞死要想到菊池病（Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease）。
features: Patchy pale eosinophilic area of necrosis within lymph node parenchyma
Abundant dot-like karyorrhectic/apoptotic debris throughout the lesion
Numerous pale histiocytes intermixed with debris
No neutrophilic abscess formation or granulomas at this magnification
Irregular transition to surrounding cellular lymphoid tissue
describe_en: Sections of lymph node show a patchy, pale eosinophilic area of necrosis containing abundant karyorrhectic apoptotic debris intermixed with numerous histiocytes. The lesion merges irregularly with the surrounding cellular lymphoid tissue. At this magnification there are no neutrophilic abscesses or well-formed granulomas. The findings are suggestive of histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis (Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease); higher-power evaluation and exclusion of lupus and infection are recommended.

ddx.vs: Lupus shows similar necrosis but may contain hematoxylin bodies and more plasma cells, and requires serologic correlation.
Granulomatous infections show caseous necrosis rimmed by epithelioid histiocytes and giant cells rather than karyorrhectic debris without granulomas.
Lymphoma shows sheets of atypical cells at the viable edge, confirmed by clonal immunophenotype.
